title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on John 18: the arrest in the garden, Peter at the door, and the questioning before Annas and Pilate.

questions.text: Where did Jesus go with his disciples after he had spoken these words?
questions.explanation: He went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, and they entered it.

answers.text: Up to the Mount of Olives
Over the brook Kidron, into a garden

questions.text: What did Judas bring with him to the place?
questions.explanation: Judas took a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, and came there with lanterns, torches and weapons.

answers.text: Soldiers and officers with lanterns and torches

questions.text: What happened when Jesus said to them, "I am he"?
questions.explanation: When he said this, they went backward and fell to the ground.

answers.text: They fell down and worshiped him
They went backward and fell down

questions.text: What was the name of the high priest's servant whose right ear Peter cut off?
questions.explanation: Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the high priest's servant, cutting off his right ear; the servant's name was Malchus.

questions.text: What did Jesus tell Peter to do with his sword?
questions.explanation: Jesus told him to put the sword into its sheath, and asked whether he should not drink the cup the Father had given him.

answers.text: To put it into its sheath
To follow him into the court
To leave it in the garden

questions.text: To whom did they lead Jesus first after they had bound him?
questions.explanation: They led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

answers.text: To the chief priests in the temple

questions.text: What did Peter answer the maid who kept the door?
questions.explanation: When she asked whether he was also one of this man's disciples, he said, "I am not."

answers.text: I do not know the man

questions.text: What happened immediately after Peter denied it again?
questions.explanation: Peter denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

answers.text: Pilate came out to the Jews

questions.text: What did Jesus answer Pilate about his Kingdom?
questions.explanation: Jesus answered that his Kingdom is not of this world, and that it is not from here.

answers.text: My Kingdom is here in Jerusalem
I have no kingdom at all
My Kingdom is not of this world
My servants will fight for it

questions.text: Whom did they shout for instead of Jesus when Pilate offered to release someone?
questions.explanation: They all shouted again, "Not this man, but Barabbas!" and Barabbas was a robber.
